'''Pal Eggs''' are various eggs that can either be obtained through [[Breeding]] or found randomly hidden in the [[Palpagos Islands|world]]. Each [[Elements|element]] has a corresponding egg. Eggs can be hatched by using any Egg Incubator. 

== Special Eggs ==
Pal Eggs have a small chance to hatch as {{i|Alpha Pals}}, and their Pal Egg size will be one size larger if they do.

There are also a chance for an egg to become a {{i|Mutated Egg}}, but that only occurs if the egg was made during [[Breeding]].

{{i|Ominous Egg}} can only be found at [[The World Tree]] and always have [[Passive Skills|World Tree Passive Skills]] when hatched.

== Egg Generation ==
All eggs have the nature of the Pal within determined when the egg was generated. The main [[Elements|Element]] of the pal determines the look of the egg.

How it chooses a species/sub species of a Pal differs somewhat based on where the egg came from.  Breeding just gives you whatever the result of breeding is. Eggs you pick up choose the species of Pal based on the map location where you pick it up. For example: the [[Mount Obsidian]] area mostly gives you {{i|Fire}} Pals.

The Rarity of an egg is determined by the rarity of the pal found within. There can be an Uncommon Large Egg  and an Epic Large Egg of the same element.
